column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each interaction/control record.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing PhysicalDurability(PhysRegistry), linking control features to the physical build.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing DeviceIdentity(DevRegistry), connecting input/interactivity data to a specific device.
A BOOLEAN showing whether ambient light sensors are present and used for adaptive brightness.
A BOOLEAN indicating if the device has a temperature sensor to track environmental or internal heat.
A BOOLEAN stating if accelerometers are included for motion detection.
A BOOLEAN indicating the presence of gyroscopes for orientation or tilt detection.
A VARCHAR(30) describing the haptic feedback system (e.g., Basic, Advanced).
A SMALLINT representing the maximum intensity or strength of the haptic feedback.
A SMALLINT counting how many vibration patterns or modes are available.
A VARCHAR(35) naming the force feedback type or system (e.g., Advanced, Basic).
A SMALLINT for trigger resistance levels or steps (on controllers with adaptive triggers).
A NUMERIC(3,1) describing trigger travel distance in millimeters.
A NUMERIC(4,2) specifying the joystick dead zone (as a ratio or percentage).
A NUMERIC(4,1) measuring joystick precision or resolution (e.g., in a scale from 0-100).
A NUMERIC(4,1) indicating spacing (in mm) between buttons (e.g., on a controller face).
A NUMERIC(4,1) describing the physical size (in mm) of face buttons or triggers.
A VARCHAR(30) naming the D-pad style/type (e.g., Hybrid, Standard, Floating).
A NUMERIC(4,1) measuring D-pad accuracy on a scale or in a test metric.
A VARCHAR(30) describing the analog stick construction/type (e.g., Standard, Magnetic, Hall Effect).
A NUMERIC(4,1) reflecting drift resistance or detection in the analog stick, measured on a scale or percentage.
